mapper.select: SELECT group_id, user_id, role, group_nickname, joined_at, muted_until FROM im_group_member WHERE group_id = #{groupId} ORDER BY joined_at ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO im_group_member (group_id, user_id, role, group_nickname, joined_at) VALUES (#{groupId}, #{userId}, #{role}, #{groupNickname}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT m.user_id AS userId, u.username, u.nickname, u.avatar, m.role, m.group_nickname AS groupNickname, m.joined_at AS joinedAt, f.status AS friendStatus FROM im_group_member m JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = m.user_id LEFT JOIN im_friend f ON f.user_id = #{viewerUserId} AND f.friend_id = m.user_id WHERE m.group_id = #{groupId} ORDER BY CASE WHEN m.role = 'owner' THEN 0 WHEN m.role = 'admin' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, m.joined_at ASC
